heroText: Billund is a small Jutland town built around LEGO, family attractions and one of Denmark's busiest airports. Most visitors come for LEGOLAND Billund, LEGO House and Lalandia, with WOW Park and Givskud Zoo trips nearby. Billund Airport sits right beside town, so transfers are short and family logistics are unusually simple.

areas.name: Billund town centre
areas.text: The small centre has practical hotels, restaurants and bus stops within a short ride or walk of the main attractions.

areas.name: LEGOLAND area
areas.text: The LEGOLAND area is best for themed hotels, early park starts and minimizing walking with children.

areas.name: Lalandia area
areas.text: The Lalandia area suits resort-style family stays with waterpark access, holiday homes and easy attraction shuttles.

areas.name: Grindsted
areas.text: Grindsted offers cheaper accommodation and local services a short drive or bus ride west of Billund.

airports.name: Billund Airport (BLL)
airports.text: Billund Airport is immediately north of town and serves LEGO visitors, Jutland trips and many international routes.

airportTransfer.value: 5-10 min by taxi, shuttle or bus to central Billund attractions

stayOverview: Stay near LEGOLAND for the easiest park mornings, around Lalandia for resort facilities, in Billund town centre for restaurants and buses, or in Grindsted for better-value accommodation with a car or bus plan.
hotelIntro: Billund hotel choice is mostly family logistics. Pay for attraction-side convenience if travelling with young children, choose Lalandia for longer resort stays, or compare Grindsted when value matters more than walking distance.
rentalCars: A car is helpful for Givskud Zoo and rural Jutland, but not necessary for airport-to-LEGOLAND stays.

history.label: 17th century
history.text: Billund is recorded as a settlement with origins in the 17th century in central Jutland.
The carpentry business later bought by Ole Kirk Christiansen was founded in Billund.
Ole Kirk Christiansen bought Billund Machine Joinery and Carpentry Business, the workshop that later led to Lego.
Christiansen named his toy business Lego, anchoring the company identity that would reshape the town.
Billund Airport opened to the public after growing from a private runway linked to the Lego company.
Legoland Billund opened as the first Legoland park, turning the town into a major family tourism base.
